mainEntity.name: Is SMS marketing legal in the UAE?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, SMS marketing is legal in the UAE, but it must follow the Telecommunications and Digital Government Regulatory Authority (TDRA) guidelines. We use only TRA-approved SMS gateways to ensure compliance.
